flow: Infectious Humans (symptomatic, age-structured)->Death Natural (humans and mosquitoes)
Infectious Humans (asymptomatic, age-structured)->Death Natural (humans and mosquitoes)
Infectious Mosquitoes Vectors->Death Natural (humans and mosquitoes)
param: a Chronological age of human host (structuring variable in PDE system)
βₕ(a) Age-dependent transmission/contact rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans (standard incidence term uses division by Nₕ(t))
βᵥ(a) Age-dependent transmission/contact rate from infectious humans (symptomatic and asymptomatic) to susceptible mosquitoes
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
k(a) Age-dependent progression rate from exposed humans to infectious humans (inverse of latent period)
ρ Probability that an exposed human becomes symptomatic infectious (fraction entering symptomatic class); 0<ρ<1

σ Reinfection intensity factor for asymptomatic humans; scales mosquito-to-human contact rate for secondary infection of asymptomatic hosts and also weights asymptomatic contribution to mosquito infection in the vector equation
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans
Nₕ(t) Total human population at time t (normalization in standard incidence terms)
B Constant influx/recruitment rate into susceptible human population (mentioned in text; boundary condition at age 0 in PDE formulation)
